hook.text: Amazon's ad revenue hit $47 billion in 2023. Sellers must now pay to be seen on a platform they already pay to sell on.

buildup.text: Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, and Display Ads fill Amazon search results. Organic visibility is shrinking.

discovery.text: The first 4-8 results on many Amazon searches are now ads. Real organic results are pushed below the fold.

twist.text: Sellers spend 10-15% of revenue on Amazon ads to maintain visibility. It's a mandatory cost, not an optional marketing.

climax.text: Amazon built a $47B ad business inside a marketplace. Sellers pay commission, FBA fees, AND advertising just to compete.

punchline.text: $47B in ad revenue. Amazon charges sellers to sell, then to be seen.

quiz.question: How much of their revenue do Amazon sellers typically spend on ads?
